# 💖 SparkArc Sponsorship & Partnership Guide

> 📩 **Contact Email**: [aideaaa@outlook.com](mailto:aideaaa@outlook.com)
> 
> If you are an **AI model proxy provider, API aggregator, or GPU compute supplier**, SparkArc is your perfect gateway to reaching high-volume, high-value token-consuming creators.

---

### What Benefits Can Sponsoring SparkArc Bring to Your Platform?

SparkArc can drive a massive volume of API calls for your platform.

*  **Provider-Based Model Management**:
Users can freely add multiple models from your platform and bind them to different purposes.
Additionally, **users can conveniently deploy the service to the public internet and designate your platform as the system provider for their downstream users.**
![alt text](support-model-image.png)
*   **High-Frequency Multi-Agent Orchestration**: After a user inputs an idea, the backend Director agent dispatches tasks to multiple specialized agents for world-building, outlining, writing, and logical auditing. A single creative session can trigger dozens of concurrent API calls.
*   **Deep Long-Text Analysis**:
    *   **Critic Audit**: Audits tens of thousands of words in novels or scripts for plot coherence and character consistency, heavily relying on long-context reasoning.
    *   **Style Cloning Analysis**: Each analysis performs multiple rounds of backtesting and fine-tuning on text chunks of 30k+ tokens, resulting in extremely high token consumption.
*   **High-Value User Base**: Our users are primarily novelists, screenwriters, game studios, and self-hosted teams. These users have strong willingness to pay, high usage stickiness, and a rigid demand for fast, stable API endpoints.

---

### 📢 Why I Need Sponsorship

I am an independent developer building and maintaining SparkArc entirely in my spare time without any steady income.

Developing and maintaining a system as large as SparkArc incurs extremely high daily costs:
1.  **Coding Expenses**: To keep the architecture excellent and ensure the project's long-term healthy development, I need to use advanced but expensive models. This burns a significant amount of tokens every single day just for writing the code itself.
2.  **Debugging and Testing Expenses**: To ensure fluid streaming collaboration and logical alignment between the Director, Critic, Scriptwriter, and other agents, we must repeatedly conduct real multi-round long-context API calls during daily development and testing, resulting in an extremely high token bill.
3.  **Public Demo Server Expenses**: We host a public instance for users to quickly experience SparkArc online, which also requires a certain amount of tokens.

Frankly, these high model invocation costs are a heavy financial burden for a solo developer without a steady income. To sustain the high-frequency iterations of this open-source project, **we are in particular need of API credit donations or testing keys from model proxy providers or API aggregators** to directly fund our development and testing. This can directly extend the life of this project.

---

### Partnership & Sponsorship Options

To provide real value to our supporters, we offer several collaboration models tailored for the open-source ecosystem:

#### 1. Recommended API Proxy Partnership
Tailored for **API aggregators and model proxy providers** seeking traffic conversion (and this is the primary form of sponsorship we are looking to trade for API credits or testing keys):
*   **Default Configuration Push**: Your API gateway configuration (platform name, `base_url`, and model mappings) will be hardcoded into the project template: `matchbox_cfg.yaml`.
*   **Downstream User Coverage**: Every self-hosted user deploying via Git, Docker, or downloading Release clients will automatically sync this recommended platform on startup.
*   **UI Premium Placement**: Featured platform name, exclusive referral link, and promotional banners in the client configuration panel and the "Recommended Services" section of the project README.

#### 2. Compute & API Key Support
If you can provide model credits and GPU compute for our **public demo instance** or **development testing**:
*   Your API channel will be integrated as a backup or main testing source for our public demo instance, with a visible credit line: "Demo API credits sponsored by XXX".
*   Dedicated links and acknowledgments in the project README.

#### 3. Corporate Sponsorship
For companies looking to raise brand awareness among developers and creators:
*   Brand Logo displayed in the sponsors' section at the top of `README.md`.
*   Backlinks on documentation pages and our official website.

#### 4. Individual Backers
For individuals wishing to support the creator:
*   We have not yet set up direct payment/donation channels for individuals (we plan to open them in the future).
*   In the meantime, your **Star**, **Watch**, and any **contributions (like submitting Issues or PRs)** are the best encouragement and sponsorship we could ask for!
